q: How do I calculate emissions from buses my school owns and runs?
title: School-owned buses emissions
short: Diesel for buses the school owns or leases and runs with its own drivers is Scope 1: multiply litres from fuel invoices by 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Buses hired with drivers from a contractor are Scope 3, and parents' own trips are student commuting.

ul: School-owned or leased buses with school drivers: Scope 1.
Buses hired with drivers from a transport contractor: Scope 3, Category 1.
Private vans or cars arranged by parents: student commuting, outside Scope 1 and 2.

p: Fuel invoices or fuel card statements per bus, route distance and the number of students on each route.
Divide by students carried, and report per route to see which routes use the most fuel per child.

example.title: Worked example: ten school buses (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Per student: 8,040 / 600 = 13.4 kg CO2 a month
example.note: Litres and student numbers are illustrative.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and fuel card statements (diesel 2.68 and CNG 2.69 kg CO2, IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 record. Hired transport goes to the Scope 3 evidence trail, and distance or tonne-km estimates are labelled as estimates.
